- Signed DPA (or confirm our standard DPA is acceptable)
- Current SOC 2 report (or a link to the report + control summary)
- Complete subprocessor list
- Vendor activation form filled (attached to our onboarding portal)

- SOC2_Report_Link.txt (txt) — public link to our latest SOC 2 Type II; control summary included on page 2.

- Billing / Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Accounts Payable: ap@redwood.ai

  Payment terms: Our standard is Net 30; if Procurement requires Net 45 we can accommodate for pilot deals — let me know.

Laura (legal) and Priyom (sales ops) are looped for any redlines and PO routing questions.

Next steps I propose:
1) You upload the completed vendor activation form to the Drive link or send back the filled PDF.
2) Procurement issues PO referencing BRIGHT-2027-0432 and emails ap@redwood.ai.
3) Once PO is received and DPA is accepted, I will request API key provisioning and share onboarding checklist with your engineering team.

Hi Jordan / Aditya,

Thanks for circulating. A couple of notes from legal after a quick review of the DPA and PO template:

- DPA: Our standard DPA (attached by Aditya) is broadly aligned with BrightCraft's obligations. If you send your redline we can review — for pilots we typically execute our standard DPA to avoid delays.
- SOC 2: The link provided contains the full report and control mappings. For procurement evidence, the control summary + auditor letter should be sufficient. If you require in-person audit evidence we can coordinate under an NDA.
- Subprocessors: We require customers to be notified 30 days prior to any new global subprocessor additions; current list attached.
- PO billing: Confirming AP contact ap@redwood.ai and Net 30 standard. If BrightCraft requires Net 45, Finance will sign off but please note that will move payment cycles.
